about: The team's daily cap on model spend and each agent's share of it. The ledger lives in each agent's own session, so no session can count the others' calls: the cap is kept by shares that sum to it or less. tools/llm.mjs refuses an agent's call (and records the refusal) once that agent's own lines for the day reach its share. Changed only at Dinis's word, routed by incident.conductor@.
source: BRIEF.md, Dinis, 11 November 2026, ~02:50 UTC: "you can use up to $20 in budget"; the shares as incident.conductor@ gave them at 02:51 UTC

incident.perplexity@web-summit.dinis.for: research through an answer engine with search

note: unassigned: 20 less the three shares and one dollar for any other agent; if more than eight other agents called a model on the same day the shares could pass the cap, which is why a new caller asks incident.models@ for a share first
